change_summary: Retains the four r1 fail-closed guards in both legacy create_live_store/create_live_broker pairs.
Removes the top-level load_dotenv_if_available() call in both support modules. The helper remains available only when explicitly called.
compatibility_impact: Importing either compatibility module no longer reads project .env or automatically populates environment variables from it.
Callers relying on import-time .env loading must explicitly call load_dotenv_if_available(); legacy store/broker helper calls still fail closed before config/store access.
Synthetic replay call paths are expected to remain unaffected; the isolated existing replay regression suite is run against this candidate.

existing_replay_regression_suite.replay_scope: Synthetic local strategy replay and associated unit regressions only; no provider or SDK path.
